project_title: OmniPOS: Universal Modular Business Operating System
executive_summary: OmniPOS is a universal, modular POS and business operating system designed to serve any organization—retail, hospitality, healthcare, education, or services. Its core differentiator is seamless migration: businesses can switch from legacy systems without starting over, thanks to a robust data import/export engine and a flexible data model. The system is built on a modular monolith architecture using Laravel (PHP) and MySQL, ensuring high performance, security, and scalability. It features strict RBAC, idempotency, rate limiting, and atomic transactions to prevent race conditions. The platform provides a unified dashboard, inventory, CRM, billing, and analytics, all customizable via modules.

tech_stack.rationale: Laravel provides a robust, secure, and scalable PHP framework with built-in support for queues, caching, and authentication. MySQL is a reliable, widely-used relational database that supports complex queries and transactions. The modular monolith architecture simplifies deployment and development while allowing future extraction to microservices if needed. This stack ensures rapid development, high performance, and enterprise-grade security.
tech_stack.frontend: Vue.js 3 with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Pinia for state management
tech_stack.infrastructure: Docker containers, Kubernetes for orchestration, AWS RDS for MySQL, Redis for caching, RabbitMQ for message queue, Nginx as reverse proxy

n_plus_one_risks.fix: Use eager loading with with('items') when fetching orders.
Eager load inventory when listing products.
Eager load orders when showing customer details.
Eager load users when listing organizations in admin panel.

missing_indexes.reason: Filtering orders by organization is common; index speeds up queries.
Foreign key to orders; index for joins and lookups.
Foreign key to products; index for stock lookups.

query_budgets.fix: Eager load items, customer, and payments; use pagination and select only needed columns.
Eager load inventory and category; use pagination and caching.
Eager load orders and addresses; use select to limit fields.
Use aggregate queries and caching for dashboard metrics.

critical.description: Weak password hashing or missing multi-factor authentication could lead to account takeover.
critical.impact: Unauthorized access to sensitive business data and financial transactions.
critical.mitigation: Use bcrypt or Argon2 for password hashing, enforce strong password policies, and implement MFA for admin roles.

critical.description: Insufficient role-based access control could allow users to access unauthorized modules or data.
critical.impact: Data breach, privilege escalation, and compliance violations.
critical.mitigation: Implement strict RBAC with least privilege principle, validate permissions on every request, and use middleware for route protection.

critical.description: Lack of idempotency on mutation endpoints could lead to duplicate orders or payments.
critical.impact: Financial loss, incorrect inventory, and customer dissatisfaction.
critical.mitigation: Require Idempotency-Key header on all POST/PUT endpoints, store keys in a unique index, and use database transactions to ensure atomicity.

high.description: SQL injection or XSS vulnerabilities could compromise data.
high.impact: Data theft, data loss, and system compromise.
high.mitigation: Use Laravel's Eloquent ORM with parameter binding, sanitize user input, and implement Content Security Policy headers.

high.description: Missing rate limiting on API endpoints could allow brute-force attacks or DoS.
high.mitigation: Apply rate limiting middleware on all API routes, especially auth and import endpoints.

high.description: Concurrent requests could cause overselling of inventory or double payment.
high.mitigation: Use database transactions with row-level locking (SELECT FOR UPDATE) for inventory updates and payment processing.

medium.description: Sensitive data in logs or error messages could be exposed.
medium.mitigation: Log only necessary information, mask sensitive fields, and use environment-specific error reporting.

medium.description: Malicious file uploads could lead to remote code execution.
medium.mitigation: Validate file types, scan for malware, store files outside web root, and use random file names.

future_features.title: AI-Powered Analytics
future_features.description: Integrate machine learning models to provide predictive sales forecasting, customer churn prediction, and inventory optimization.
future_features.business_value: Enables data-driven decisions, reduces waste, and increases revenue.

future_features.title: Offline Mode
future_features.description: Allow POS operations to continue offline and sync when connectivity is restored.
future_features.business_value: Ensures business continuity in areas with unreliable internet, increasing reliability.

future_features.title: Multi-Currency and Multi-Language
future_features.description: Support for multiple currencies and languages to cater to global organizations.
future_features.business_value: Expands market reach and improves user experience for international clients.

future_features.title: Advanced Reporting and BI
future_features.description: Customizable dashboards and report builder with export options.
future_features.business_value: Empowers managers with actionable insights and simplifies compliance reporting.
